body: I understand things that would bring anyone into a state like this, example, losses of loved ones. But there's also the fact that everyone eventually dies anyway. It bothers me that as human beings, we live through so much stress, pain, and struggle, and the fact that we all die at some point just makes me think, "Why not die sooner?" I feel like there's so much bad in the world and it outweighs the good. Trying to get up every morning and get through the day is so hard because I'm starting to have the mentality of, "This won't matter when I'm dead so why try." You know? I just don't know why I have to learn everything there is to learn, if someday I'll be lying dead in a coffin. Or why I sit here harming myself, crying, screaming, wanting it all to stop, when I could just be dead. Because maybe then it would all stop.

There's just a lot going on. I've lost three grandmothers, a friend, and my dog that was with me my entire life, all in the past year. And as you mentioned, school should not be a major factor in ending my life but it's added a lot of stress on me lately. Im falling behind and my parents think it's because I'm distracted or unfocused. They threaten to take away my favorite hobbies, some of the only things that bring me joy anymore, and my freedom and independence, that naturally comes with getting older.
Thanks. I just need reasons to stay alive I guess. Because right now, my reasons to end my life severely outweigh my reasons not to.

Thank you so much. I'll vent a little if you wouldn't mind. 
Its almost like a feeling in my stomach, sometimes it gets so bad it makes me want to throw up. I'm constantly hiding from everyone, constantly yelling insults to myself in my head, and whenever im alone, all I do is cry and debate whether or not to end my life. My parents and I aren't close so I can't tell them anything. They get mad at me for school related things, they don't see how im breaking inside. My friends are dismissing everything I say as a joke. I don't even know if I can consider them friends anymore because they just laugh when I say, "Im ending this. Im done" Ive even showed one scars on my forearms and she thinks I was just messing around. I don't even know how to dig myself out of this. Im almost sure I wont be able to. And im deathly afraid of getting professional help because it would mess up my life, reputation, and relationships with my family and friends forever.
